# systeam_service (Resource)

Manages a service: an org-scoped catalog entry that incidents and checks attach to, with an owning team, an escalation policy, and notification channels.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The service's display name.
- `organization_id` (Number) The ID of the organization this service belongs to.

### Optional

- `description` (String) An optional description.
- `docs_url` (String) Link to the service's documentation.
- `escalation_policy_id` (Number) The escalation policy incidents on this service route to.
- `notification_channel_ids` (Set of Number) Notification channels attached to this service.
- `owner_team_id` (Number) The team that owns this service.
- `repo_url` (String) Link to the service's source repository.
- `tier` (String) Criticality tier: P1 (highest) through P4.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The unique identifier of the service.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the service is active.
- `slug` (String) URL-safe identifier, generated from the name.
